prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: a finished Chinese video thumbnail/title-cover for the CK3 mod 《超人强：越超人越强》.
Create ONE polished landscape cover, EXACT 16:9 aspect ratio, 2048 × 1152 pixels.
Input image 1 is a BRAND / CHARACTER / ART-STYLE REFERENCE, not an instruction to retain the square poster layout.
The cover must sell the same mature medieval royal power fantasy and intrigue as the reference: one clearly adult crowned king (male, late 30s) and one clearly adult crowned queen (female, late 30s), both recognizably distinct, detailed expressive faces, rich red and black embroidered court dress, gold crowns and fur, Gothic palace, golden magical strands flowing between them. Fully clothed. The queen's direct, calculating gaze makes the viewer wonder who actually controls the encounter. No extra protagonist and no male replacement for the queen.
Recompose the reference into a bold wide VIDEO thumbnail with a compact core design that can later be reframed to 4:3 while preserving the SAME faces, poses, words and effects. Medium-close framing, both complete crowns safely inside the image, the adult king central/right foreground and the queen right behind him; reserve left 40–45% for bold typography against a very dark plum-black palace shadow. No tiny floating skill icons or complicated diagram.
Gold light arcs diagonally from queen to king, strong face and hand highlights, cinematic chiaroscuro, deep burgundy, black and antique gold, high quality realistic game promotional key art, sumptuous but uncluttered. Their confident expressions convey seduction, ambition and danger without explicit sexual activity.
Exact Chinese text only:
Top-left small identifier: "CK3 模组"
Left dominant huge embossed gold title: "超人强"
Below title smaller elegant ivory line: "越超人越强"
Below that a large, very readable dramatic two-line teaser: "赴约之前" then "谁才是猎物？" (second line is pale gold and visually emphasized).
Every Chinese character must be correct, with tasteful weight and spacious clean typesetting, large enough to read as a small thumbnail. Keep all text and both faces at least 7% from canvas edges and away from the bottom-right video-duration badge area.
No other text, no 宣传插画/宣传示意 labels, no watermark, no Steam logo, no QR code, no screenshot/UI frames, no sexual acts, no nudity, no collage panels.
This is the 16:9 MASTER of a matching pair; deliver a single image without displaying alternate crops or two panels.
